_doc: PLAN.md 5.2. How enemy pilots fly. Each tick a behaviour picks a velocity it wants (U/s, world space); the stick steers toward it (stick = (wanted - velocity) / (top speed x steer_gain), at most 1), so the flight model turns and burns just as it does for the player. With nothing left to correct (stick under face_below), the ship keeps its nose on its aim at face_stick, just past the stick's dead zone, so it turns without pushing (fixed guns line up). A ship whose back push is under turn_first_below of its forward push turns round to brake: the stick is held at most 90 degrees off its nose. Closing on its aim more than overspeed U/s too fast while facing within brake_facing_deg of it, it lets go of the stick: the auto-brake slows it with the nose kept on. It approaches no faster than it could stop: a chaser (nose on) at its back push, others at that or turn_and_burn_share of their forward push, whichever is more (never under min_brake). top speed is the ship's forward push / (mass x linear_damp). Distances in U; a share is of the ship's longest gun range (range_default_u for a ship without guns).

chase._doc: Close to stand_off_u behind the lead point and hold there, nose on it.

strafe._doc: Circle the target at radius_share of range, at speed_share of top speed.

keep_range._doc: Stay between min_share and max_share of range, nose on the target.

ram._doc: Full speed at where the target will be.

lay_mines._doc: Circle close, so mines drop across the target's path.

convoy._doc: The carrier the player escorts (12.3): on to each waypoint (within reach_u counts as there) at cruise_share of top speed, whatever shoots at it; its turrets fight.

escort._doc: An enemy guarding a ship (a boss's escorts, 12.2): hold a post offset_u beside it; with an enemy within guard_u of that ship, the post moves between the two and its turrets fight.
